title: rrsi.harness.daily/1
description: One America/Los_Angeles day of the struggle-rate measurement: harness-fixable struggle episodes (rrsi-mine traces, labelled with the canonical vocabulary) per 1,000 agent tool calls, by host and by pattern. Written by `python -m rrsi harness measure` as OUT/daily/<day>.json; OUT/series.jsonl carries the same numbers as dashboard series. Counts only; never transcript text.

closed.description: true once the day ended (23:59:59 in the timezone) before computed_at; an open day is partial and is recomputed by the next run

revision.description: rrsi git revision that computed the record (the procedure's version)

vocabulary.description: fingerprint of patterns.json; a change of vocabulary is a change of method

sessions.description: sessions with a tool call or an episode that day

tool_calls.description: the denominator: tool calls started that day, all hosts

labelled.description: episodes with a label; episodes - labelled are unlabelled and make the rate a lower bound

struggles.description: the numerator: labelled, non-noise, harness-fixable episodes

rate_per_1k.description: struggles per 1,000 tool calls; null when there were no tool calls (no data, not a zero)

uncanonical.description: new_pattern escapes seen that day: raw slug -> episodes

ci.description: 95% interval of rate_per_1k (Garwood exact Poisson bounds via the Wilson-Hilferty approximation); null with rate_per_1k
